This '''mission''' was an attempt to capture a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] that had left the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Republic dispatched the young [[Trachta]] along with several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in order the capture the [[Unidentified Dark Jedi Padawan|Padawan]]. When the Padawan was surrounded it surprised Trachta and his men with a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] which he threw with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], several Clone Troopers died while Trachta lost both his arms. Trachta was brought back to Coruscant for treatment, where his arms and eyes were replaced with cybernetics, as well as his damaged respiratory system.

[[File:Trachta_Clone_Wars.jpg|thumb|left|Trachta and his clones hunting the Padawan.]]
